acceptanceCriteria: A regression with a default-export-only page object yields an UNRESOLVED import and no call.
Named exports still scaffold the import and call unchanged.
body: Found by the gh660 lane on 2026-10-07 in gh657 code (V1-0956, claude/gh657 6a1dab87). ProjectScaffold (internal/appmap/scaffold.go ~264-271) writes `import { Class } from` and a method call even when the class is not exported by name; classLine in internal/appmap/tests.go also accepts `export default class`. Reproduce: make the page object `export default class X` with no named importer and run `flows appmap scaffold`. Expected: the import is reported UNRESOLVED and no call is emitted. Actual: `import { X } from` plus a call.
title: appmap scaffold emits a named import and call for a page object that is only a default export
